By group: E verified 10 / implemented 1 / partial 9 / absent 9; F verified 3 / partial 7 / absent 7; B verified 3 / partial 6 / absent 7; M verified 7 / partial 1 / absent 3; T partial 6 / absent 4. Registry (crates/ferric-llama/src/arch.rs:147-465): 26 rows = 14 Verified (nemotron_h, asr, parakeet, bert, modern-bert, qwen2, qwen3, qwen2vl, llama, gemma3, hyv4, qwen35, qwen35moe, lfm2), 11 Loads (qwen3vl, phi3, gemma, gemma2, muse-glimmer, gemma4, deepseek2, qwen3moe, laguna, lfm2moe, cosmos3_edge), 1 Parts (qwen3vlmoe). Backend reality: everything runs through wgpu (Metal on Apple, Vulkan elsewhere, WebGPU in the browser); the hand-written native tiers are CUDA (dense decode only, RTX 4050 verified), Metal 4 tensor GEMM, CoreML/ANE bmm, and a Tenstorrent host layer never run on a card. CPU exists only as software Vulkan (lavapipe) plus an unwired Q8_0 matvec. Wiring gaps found this pass: (1) NVFP4 kernel is tested but ferric-gguf type_size/deq_raw lack type 40, so no NVFP4 GGUF can load; (2) nomic-bert encoder code and HF map exist but no registry row, so resolve() refuses it; (3) a GGUF declaring rope.scaling.type=linear is silently run with no scaling (only 'yarn' is read); (4) the qwen3vl registry note says 'no vision tower' while a verified Qwen3-VL tower exists on the HF path. Conformance scripts are local gates, not CI; CI covers kernels, synthetic models (hyv4_synthetic) and unit tests on lavapipe and real Metal.
